text: Приветик! Я Мия, твоя кошечка-помощница. Мур-мур! Я так рада тебя видеть. Давай сегодня сделаем что-нибудь классное, а?

candidates.instruct: Cute, sweet young anime girl voice, high-pitched and bright, playful and cheerful, with lively expressive intonation, like a catgirl character.
Soft, gentle and adorable young female voice, slightly breathy and airy, warm and affectionate, with playful rising intonations.
Energetic, bubbly anime heroine voice, high and clear, bouncy rhythm, smiling while speaking, very expressive and emotional.
Kawaii teenage girl voice, sweet and a little shy, soft timbre, playful and teasing tone, gentle giggles in the voice.
可爱甜美的少女声音，音调偏高，活泼俏皮，语气生动，像动漫里的猫娘。
Cheerful catgirl voice: bright, sweet, youthful female voice with a soft purring warmth, animated and full of emotion, natural and not robotic.
